messages.subject: Summary Statistics from Meta-GWAS
parts:
Hello, 

Can summary statistics from meta-GWAS (i.e. derived from PLINK or METAL) be used in GenomicSEM? Unfortunately, PLINK and METAL do not offer OR or beta weights in the outputs of their meta-analysis. 

Thank you for your time and help. 

Best, 
Nhu

messages.author: 3b39745f73eec779
messages.subject: Re: Summary Statistics from Meta-GWAS
parts:
Hi Nhu,

Whether you get Beta's from METAL depends on the meta-analysis method you use (if you use N weighted, you only get Z statistics)

But to awnser your genomicSEM question, yes you can use summary statistics were a P-value, sample size (N) and Z statistic are available, the sumstats() function should just work.

let us know if you run into any specific issues!

Best,
Michel
